note: Generated by tools/connect-directory.mjs --write from the tool list the live server answers; the justification of each tool is hand-written and kept.

tools.name: whoami_and_credits
tools.title: Who am I, and my credits
tools.justification: Read-only. Shows only the connected person's own account name, credit balance and how this connection is limited. Changes nothing.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.justification: Read-only. Lists only the connected person's own film projects (titles and states).

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.justification: Writes one new, empty project for the connected person. Free. Asking again with the same title returns the existing project instead of making a second one, so a retry is safe. Deletes and replaces nothing.

tools.name: get_story_schema
tools.title: Story format and engine rules
tools.justification: Read-only. Returns the story format, plain-words engine rules, the dataset catalogue and a small example. The same for every person; no account data.

tools.name: set_story
tools.title: Save the story
tools.justification: Destructive by definition: it REPLACES the project's saved working story. The new story is saved only if every check passes; otherwise nothing is saved and each failed check is listed. It never starts a film, never spends credits and never touches another project.

tools.name: set_compilation_request
tools.title: Ask for a compilation
tools.justification: Destructive by definition: it REPLACES the project's saved compilation request. It is data only (a phrase, a few choices and a folder name); nothing is fetched, cut or run, and the person starts any build themself in the Ryagram app.

tools.name: make_contact_sheet
tools.title: Make a contact sheet
tools.justification: Not read-only: it queues a free job that draws still frames of the person's own saved story and runs the full correctness checks. A connection cannot spend credits, so a job that would cost any is refused in words. Repeating it queues another job (not idempotent). Deletes nothing.

tools.name: make_preview
tools.title: Make a preview
tools.justification: Not read-only: it queues a preview of at most 10 seconds of the person's saved story. The first few per project are free; after that a connection cannot spend credits and is told so in words. Repeating it queues another job (not idempotent). Deletes nothing.

tools.name: job_status
tools.title: Job status
tools.justification: Read-only. Reports the state of one of the person's own jobs (queued, running, finished, or why it stopped).

tools.name: get_film_link
tools.title: Links to results
tools.justification: Read-only. Returns where to see the person's own finished contact sheet, preview and film; links are short-lived or point to the person's own Ryagram page, where they sign in.

tools.name: get_edit_state
tools.title: See the person's open editor
tools.justification: Read-only. Shows what is in the person's open editor for one project: the look settings changed, which settings may be changed, and clip names and times only if the person ticked the box that lets their AI see them.

tools.name: set_look
tools.title: Change the look in the person's open editor
tools.justification: Not read-only: it changes look settings (such as colours) in the person's own open editor, 1 to 20 at a time, as drafts the person sees within seconds and can undo (undo_my_changes, or their own undo). It replaces no saved film and no story.

tools.name: edit_tracks
tools.title: Change the clip list of a compilation
tools.justification: Not read-only: it changes the person's compilation clip list in their own open editor (move, trim, reorder, set text), as drafts they see and can undo. It never touches the person's video files, only the list.

tools.name: undo_my_changes
tools.title: Take back my last batch of changes
tools.justification: Not read-only: it takes back only this connection's own most recent batch of editor changes on one project, never the person's own edits. A setting the person changed since stays as they left it.

tools.name: request_download
tools.title: Ask to download a public data file
tools.justification: Not read-only, but data only: it writes down a plan (an https address, a short reason and a folder name). Ryagram downloads nothing and the assistant never receives the file: the person opens the Ryagram desktop app, sees the website, file name and size, and presses Download themselves, or says no. At most 5 plans wait at once and 20 are accepted a day.

tools.name: list_my_downloads
tools.title: See my download requests
tools.justification: Read-only. Lists the download plans written for the person (newest first, at most 20) with their state.

tools.name: suggest_next_step
tools.title: What to ask the person next
tools.justification: Read-only. Works out the one next question or step from the details the person has already given, so the assistant does not ask twice. Stores nothing and reads no project data.
